policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Dallas Baptist remains the division's lone unbeaten program The Lone Star side leads the division with twenty wins and two draws after beating Western Washington. It has scored 70 goals while conceding ten, and faces North Georgia next.
claims.note: held against every other programme; the nearest is franklin-pierce at 18
